statement: Uses the tricks image from Discord as framework for the video but some of it is outdated or copy-pasted from older versions.
A spreadsheet linked in description and pinned comment covers all statue week setups; sampling especially can be min-maxed.
Pump your statues before statue week; focus Feasty (from Poops; can candy it) and the mining and lumber statues (from reward one crystals; best via RG).
Best way to get mining and lumber statues from reward one crystals is always RG.
Ancient golem dragon statue from Home multiplies all statues; merit says 3x but it is closer to 10x to everything in statues.
Statue multiplier enables things like arcane cultist pushing deeper into emperor runs.
Statue week might be the best merit; if not it's second with monument being the other best in the current meta.
Copper prints are the biggest sampling target this week for most players because mechanics scale them linearly.
Very early in the game oak prints on your majors might be better than copper.
Hole in world five bravery monument mining efficiency scales copper prints linearly; he has over a million.
Do the bravery monument this week for extra mining efficiency to push copper prints; do not run the other monuments.
Resample copper now: reached about 3e21 a 50x increase over previous best even with an 18x daily multiplier; then forget until next statue week.
Sample flies and goldfish (and oak) because of tome entries.
Do a V-man speed run killing all reachable bosses then a G-mush print for tome and to infinitely set up refinery salt.
Sample cereals lenses fibers from world one sandy pot sand giga frogs resource flies and whispy woods so refinery runs forever.
Also sample flutes among main refinery resources.
Consider world seven prints for annoying mob drops passively; important for vials and likely the final print page.
Print clam works resource before doing clam works especially on an earlier worker class since weaker damage gives higher multi kill and bigger print.
Clam works resource is annoying to get so sample it at minimum for the green stack.
Sampling annoying craft resources like frisbees is fun to get the green stack; otherwise sampling needs nothing extra.
Go character by character to mining chopping fishing and catching and drop a 24-hour candy for many levels.
Mine at Godshards and fish at Seasalt Islands with a 24-hour candy; set up cards and sets and use the sampling sheet to min-max.
Catch at the firefly node in world six and drop another 24-hour candy at Sky Doggies.
Candies give literally months of skill gains which matter for efficiency and mechanics requiring deeper skill pushes.
Cook leveling is on the menu: click and hold green balloons for many levels; the old tech being fixed takes little time.
You can keep clicking eggs past just filling to level eggs in the incubator.
Current meta is dropping 700 eggs per cycle then claiming; he just goes until all are god shard; earlier players might prefer 700 per cycle.
Push class of cans soul in world four; best soul for worship XP; use all quick for a ton of experience.
Go to the latest critter unlocked and use green balloons on the blobs to level trapping instead of being time gated.
Use the best non-metal crop you can unlock usually glassy crop for the most farming EXP.
Optimize with farming skill XP in land rank but the statue does most of the heavy lifting.
Use the goat prayer in world five (floterpus) to get divinity and lab EXP simultaneously by having characters in lab.
For singularities you need to be on the physical platform to get hours.
Put ACs in lab: transferral talent gives their lab EXP to your lowest lab member.
Stay in the final cavern or latest unlocked chapter (5 6 7 great) for hundreds of levels in minutes.
He started around 500-550 and is now at about 650 with front runners at 745; extremely important week for spelunking XP.
Use AC not DK for emperor; DK cannot outscale AC even with extremely juiced refinery; the screenshot advice is outdated.
Go to world 6 Emperor itself and set up damage setup there.
Use skull and aura; aura heals on top platform from boss hits; skulls are highest DPS; nothing else to avoid weakening rotation.
Talents on the second page give huge damage; get cards going and double DPS sources.
Stand on small platform next to boss and hit auto; auto attacks spawn skulls that bounce back and forth like a blender.
Just stand and auto even though spinning blades heal the boss; more DPS anyway than min-maxing.
Pace to win robe or better robe wings add damage; most players run out of attempts before needing them.
Cold seekers and midnight cookies give heavy lifting; kebabs also; boost foods do most because Feasty and dragon statue multiply foods.
Emperor pushing is done in statue week because Feasty converts into boost foods and dragon statue multiplies Feasty.
He is at about emperor 183 not even completely min-maxed and tearing the boss down.
Go to Shimmer Island for a new DPS record; his is 1.6e45 up from about e43.
Also do your dog den; third setup shown.
Max everything is common advice but he found a junk setup works better; do your own testing; might add cloud.
Concoctions can help in later dogs with lots of health as a four to five x damage multi.
Do dog den on each archetype: mage warrior archer and beginner.
A villager buff needs deep runs on each character; AC gets the deepest and gets you to next opal.
His next opal is at 7 billion; on track; will do a min-max run later with wings on.
Drop the purple concoction potion on dogs for much more damage; later health scales past kill point so min-max run later.
Dog den is not an exact science; try different setups including max everything.
Disagrees with sheet recommending AC at Deck Hands for alchemy levels; outdated.
Flat maps like Dreadnought or new maps are better for alchemy levels; he favors Windwalker for active.
Better way to level alchemy: get syrups from spelunking and drop hundreds of syrup into alchemy; more efficient than deck hands active.
Sheet says RG money farming at deck hands; he disagrees; final map pufferfins is best for both EXP and coins.
Do daily crystals on the final map pufferfins rather than deck hands.
Sheet misses node pushing in hole: push Motherload Evatory Flak Fractal Fly and Trench Fish with the respective class.
Put one boost food each time per node (benefits from Feasty) and one class per node; expect around 50 on each.
Doing this should give about five or six extra depths per node.
Put both RGs on spelunking since pit of pages is broken for all characters but still works for the royal garden.
Use active Wind Walker to push shinies in Lumina's menagerie; pump each type to 24-25 then move on; aim later for 27-30.
V-man enhancement: 50% chance to reduce incubator time by 3 seconds applies to shinies too; millions of days gained.
Could do some egg XP on one active or a half or full day of RG coin farming but Wind Walker is best.
Casual minimum: copper resample emperor attempts with AC one candy per initial four skills per character and dog den (about 3 minutes).
AFK: put characters on divinity or lab and others on the best spelunking tunnel.
Active AFK options: Wind Walker for shinies RG for coins or AC on high-density mob map like Magma; Dreadnoughts tunnel worms citrins.
World four AC options maybe flumps or pillars; if still in world four you have other problems.
Statue week gives months if not years of progress; especially now due to Lumina's menagerie pushing as deep as possible is current meta.
Next week's merit is gaming: click harvest all repeatedly for 7 days and hope a better merit comes up.
